title: Falling appart after second wash
text:
Falling appart after second wash. Seller was very nice (in spite of me being upset about some weird charge that appeared out of nowher in my order) and the item is lovely. The only things I'd caution you about if you are considering buying this iteam: make sure that you look at shipping charges in advance and also wash separatedly with cold water as this will stain other clothes in the same laundry load. Not sure how the color will stay vibrant after a few washes...will update when I know.

**UPDATE** I have washed this quilt for the second time...both times inside a protective bag (for delicates) in the delicate cycle of our washer. When I took it out most of the seams (edges all around) were frayed and coming undone. Very poor job. I am guessing this won't survive a third wash...so I downgraded it from five stars to one as, in the end, no matter how polite the seller is, if it won't withstand more than one wash it is the same as throwing your money away. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND. Save your money and buy something old and well made or new and sturdy...you get what you pay for, so true.
